items.title: Philippines, Japan vow to deepen strategic partnership
items.description: President Marcos met with Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi yesterday on the sidelines of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit and Related Summits where they reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthen the two countries’ strategic partnership.

items.title: Government seeks to reduce US tariff during Trump visit
items.description: The Philippines wants to see a reduction in the 12.5 percent tariff being imposed on its exports to the United States when President Marcos and US President Donald Trump meet in Manila this week.

items.title: SC: Seafarers’ bond for seeking damages unconstitutional
items.description: The Supreme Court has rendered unconstitutional a bond requirement for seafarers seeking to execute monetary awards and damages under Republic Act 12021 or the Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers.

items.title: Political will, partnerships needed to achieve SDGs
items.description: With only less than half of the Sustainable Development Goals progressing as planned, President Marcos yesterday called for political will and enhanced partnerships to meet the targets requiring global action on poverty, inequality and other problems.

items.title: 600,000 OFWs to benefit from ASEAN migrant worker declaration
items.description: Around 600,000 overseas Filipino workers across Southeast Asia stand to benefit from the adoption by ASEAN leaders of the Philippine-spearheaded “ASEAN Declaration on Fair, Ethical and Sustainable Recruitment for Empowered Migrant Workers.”

items.title: Calibrated restoration eyed for Myanmar representation
items.description: Leaders of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations have decided to pursue a calibrated engagement, step-by-step and progress-based approach to restore Myanmar’s political representation.

items.title: TikTok, DOT launch interactive virtual heritage site tours
items.description: The Department of Tourism has tapped social media platform TikTok to promote UNESCO-recognized heritage sites in the country through immersive livestreaming tours.

items.title: Creation of ASEAN haze pollution center pushed
items.description: Southeast Asian leaders urged ASEAN member-states to prioritize the ratification of an agreement establishing the ASEAN Coordinating Center for Transboundary Haze Pollution Control to make the center operational.

items.title: Philippines, Australia reaffirm defense ties
items.description: The Philippines and Australia yesterday reaffirmed their defense ties as they expressed “concern over what they described as “coercive, aggressive and dangerous” against Filipino ships in the South China Sea.
